subject: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity extracts & retention runbook
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@medsystems.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsystems.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SOC 2 review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 intake call last week. Our auditor has asked for a concise package of admin activity evidence covering the last 12 months. Specifically they want: 
- Records of admin user creation, role changes, permission grants/revokes, and MFA enrollment changes.
- Exportable logs showing the who/what/when for admin console actions (with timestamps and actor emails)
- Retention policy and proof of export capabilities (S3/BigQuery or downloadable csv)

Can you confirm what we can provide, the export formats, and any redaction we apply to sensitive fields? Also timeline — we need delivery to the auditor by 2026-04-07.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Security & Compliance Lead
MedSystems Inc.

[No attachments]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@medsystems.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SOC 2 review

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the deadline. We can package the requested admin activity evidence. High-level plan: 

1) What we will include:
- Admin activity stream (user/actor, action type, target resource, timestamp, IP, request id).
- Change details for role/grant/revoke and user lifecycle events (created, disabled, deleted).
- MFA enrollment/disable events for console users.

2) Formats & delivery:
- Primary export: compressed CSV(s) with a JSON schema manifest. We can also provide a BigQuery export snapshot (read-only) or S3 export (signed URL).
- For SIG/CAIQ reviewers who prefer samples, we’ll include a sanitized sample CSV and a full encrypted bundle for the auditor.

3) Retention policy & attestations:
- Default retention: 13 months for admin activity by default (configurable per tenant via policy).
- We’ll include log retention config screenshots and a data retention statement signed by our Security team.

4) Redaction & PII handling:
- We redact session tokens and secret material. Email addresses of admin actors are preserved (auditor requires identity). We can pseudonymize if needed for non-audit distribution.

Action items: Neha, can you draft the runbook for extract steps (S3/BigQuery/CSV), and attach a log sample + manifest? Sergio, can you confirm encryption and S3 signed-url timeline? Elena, does the auditor require a specific checksum/hashing for the bundle?

I’ll circulate the assembled package as soon as Neha uploads the runbook and sample.

Thanks,
Rachel
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none yet
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@medsystems.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SOC 2 review

Hi all — draft runbook and sample exports attached. Summary below and exact commands are in admin_activity_runbook_v1.2.pdf: 

- What’s logged: admin user lifecycle (create, update, disable, delete), role grants/revokes, policy changes, MFA enroll/disable, API token create/delete, console sign-in attempts flagged as admin-level. Each record includes actor_email, actor_id, action, target_resource, timestamp_utc, ip_address, request_id, and metadata blob.

- Retention & storage: logs are ingested into our OLTP cluster and replicated to audit-s3 daily. Retention policy is 13 months by default; retention is enforced by lifecycle rules and immutable snapshots for the audit window (we create read-only monthly snapshots for audit requests).

- Export options and commands (included in runbook):
  * S3 export: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/<tenant>/admin/2026-03-01-2026-03-31/ ./ and then gzip. Signed URL for download (48h TTL) generated via presign.
  * BigQuery: we can grant auditor read-only access to a snapshot dataset named redwood_audits.<tenant>_snapshot_YYYYMM.
  * CSV: we supply partitioned CSVs (by month) and a manifest.json describing fields and any masked columns.

- Packaging & integrity: we will produce an encrypted tarball (AES-256) and provide SHA256 checksum. If DocuSign/chain-of-custody required, we can seed that process with the checksum and manifest entry.

- Timeline: I can generate the sample bundle and manifest today and the full 12-month extract by EOD 2026-04-02. Sergio — will need an encrypted S3 bucket + presigned URL ETA.

Attachments: admin_activity_runbook_v1.2.pdf; log_export_sample_202603.csv

-Neha
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
